randomControl.sampling: uniform with replacement over scheduled minute opens from firstEligibleMinute through entry expiry; require minute close<=entry expiry; select before inspecting outcomes; unavailable draws stay unavailable, no replacement
randomControl.entry: selected candle open; market-style sanity control, no future price to select time
randomControl.geometry: preserve V0 absolute stop and TP distances translated to sampled open; same direction
randomControl.horizon: original cutoff+72h, not 72h after random entry
randomControl.eligibility: valid V0 presignal geometry and instrument mapping only

prng.name: LCG32
prng.initialState: seed unsigned32; independent reset for bootstrap and random control; reset bootstrap per policy

execution.partialBoundaryCandles: Entry expiry: partial candle excluded; valid still-waiting path becomes UNFILLED after eligible set exhausted. Outcome-horizon partial candle semantics unchanged; no lookahead or forced close.
execution.fill: all variants fixed level touch; low<=Entry<=high; no improvement
execution.entryCandleExit: if open==Entry use active-position rules; otherwise any reachable SL or TP in fill candle is AMBIGUOUS
execution.entryGap: if favorable-side open and Entry not in range: AMBIGUOUS_ENTRY; if Entry in range use fixed-level fill subject to entryCandleExit
execution.stopBeforeFill: without reachable Entry, proven Stop touch invalidates order; simultaneous levels unresolved; never presume continuous inter-candle path
execution.postFill: open beyond SL executes at open first; open at/beyond TP executes at TP; otherwise both SL/TP touched=AMBIGUOUS; single level=level price
execution.missingData: no interpolation; duplicates/conflicts/disorder/unconfirmed/invalid OHLC/mapping/gaps => DATA_UNAVAILABLE if needed path affected

expiryCorrection.closeTimeDefinition: openTime + 60000 milliseconds, same simulator boundary convention
expiryCorrection.eligible: openTime > original cutoff AND closeTime <= entryExpiry
expiryCorrection.afterBoundary: INELIGIBLE; never inspect to infer pre-expiry entry
expiryCorrection.exhaustedEligibleCandles: If still waiting, all required eligible data valid, and no prior terminal/invalidation/ambiguity: UNFILLED
expiryCorrection.partialMinuteAlone: Not DATA_UNAVAILABLE, AMBIGUOUS_ENTRY or UNRESOLVED_OPEN; outside admissible entry set
expiryCorrection.preserveEarlierStates: Genuine missing/invalid required data and earlier ambiguity/invalidation are not converted to UNFILLED. Already-filled positions retain the original outcome horizon and rules.

primary.question: Does frozen V1 improve model Net R relative to V0 under corrected expiry?
primary.pairing: Both V0 and V1 have finite numeric model netR; join by exact frozen tradeId; no sign/profit filter; no V2/V3 eligibility condition
report: 95% day-cluster bootstrap CI for mean paired difference
unknownStates: any other genuinely unknown model netR
primary.emptyPair: INVALID / NOT INTERPRETABLE; no fabricated estimate or CI

bootstrap.sampling: D UTC signal-days of paired cohort with replacement; copy complete day clusters; sum paired differences / sampled trade count; same draws for V0 and V1; not equally weighted daily means
targets: PRIMARY V1-V0 paired Net mean difference
SECONDARY v1.0 comparisons on all-four resolved intersection
bootstrap.net: Frozen fee model applied; primary Net comparison defined above

decision.invalid: Material simulator/data integrity problem, or primary estimate/CI unavailable
decision.improved: mean paired Net R difference > 0 AND CI lower > 0
decision.notImproved: mean paired Net R difference <= 0 OR CI upper <= 0
decision.inconclusive: mean paired Net R difference > 0 AND CI lower <= 0 <= CI upper (unless prior rule applies)

reporting.availabilityMatrix: V0 numeric/nonnumeric x V1 numeric/nonnumeric; totals reconcile to 91; V1_V0_PAIR_AVAILABLE_N
reporting.remainingAsymmetry: Explicit discussion required; no hidden attrition
reporting.secondary: V2/V3 remain secondary; retain v1.0 all-four resolved intersection for secondary comparisons; never use it as primary V1/V0 denominator

E: no eligible touch yields UNFILLED if no earlier invalidation/ambiguity/data defect

H: outcomes not logically affected by expiry correction identical to v1.0
